quests.title: Don Giuvanni - Don Giuvanni's Hair

Bring everything back to JOKER.

source.from: Exchange for 1x Memory Projector + 1x Hologram Source + 1x DNA Sensor + 1x Don Giuvanni's Hair with Inventor Gale at Underground Dev Room - Lobby

quests.notes: The code is 12487257. Memory Kit 1 is obtained by compounding Memory Projector + Hologram Source + DNA Sensor + Don Giuvanni's Hair with Inventor Gale at Underground Dev Room - Lobby. Memory Projector and Hologram Source are dropped by Win16 Worm (Lv.232). DNA Sensor is dropped by Thief Mole (Lv.227). Don Giuvanni's Hair is obtained by completing Don Giuvanni - Don Giuvanni's Hair.
